tool_call_format: xml: a <tools> block of JSON tool schemas in the system turn, then <tool_call><function=NAME><parameter=K>V</parameter></function></tool_call> per call
known_template_errors: Unexpected message role. (role developer, or any role other than system/user/assistant/tool)
System message must be at the beginning. (system message at index > 0)
No user query found in messages. (history with no plain user turn, e.g. a tool-only continuation)
notes:
Qwen3.5 GGUF ships one template (no named variants). reasoning_effort is never referenced: all six levels render byte-identical to the no-effort render, so effort is silently ignored, not rejected (at the server level b11960 special-cases effort 'none': it sets enable_thinking=false and drops the kwarg, so 'none' still turns thinking off). Thinking is controlled by enable_thinking at the generation prompt: true emits ' thinking
', false or absent emits ' thinking

</think>

' (an empty think block). llama.cpp b11960 maps a developer message to system before rendering, so a leading developer message works; one in mid-history becomes a non-first system message and raises. Tool parameters render only when tool_call.function.arguments is a mapping; with the OpenAI string form the template emits an empty <function=NAME></function> (b11960 converts string arguments to objects for this template because its caps probe sees object-argument use).
